question_vi: Cạm bẫy của clone()/Cloneable là gì và giải pháp thay thế?
question_en: What are the pitfalls of clone()/Cloneable, and what are the alternatives?
answer_html_vi:
clone() nằm ở Object nhưng cơ chế rối:
- Cloneable là marker rỗng — không hề khai báo method clone(). Nó chỉ bật cờ để Object.clone() khỏi ném CloneNotSupportedException. Một interface không định nghĩa hành vi → phản trực giác.
- Object.clone() copy nông (shallow): chỉ sao field bề mặt; field tham chiếu (list, mảng, object lồng) vẫn dùng chung → sửa bản clone làm hỏng bản gốc.
- Không gọi constructor, khó dùng với field final, phải cast thủ công.

java
class Team implements Cloneable {
  List<String> members;
  @Override public Team clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
    Team t = (Team) super.clone();
    t.members = new ArrayList<>(members); // deep-copy thủ công từng field
    return t;
  }
}

Thay thế (khuyên dùng):
- Copy constructor: new Team(other) — rõ ràng, hỗ trợ final.
- Static factory: Team.copyOf(other).
- Object bất biến thì không cần clone.

(Effective Java Item 13 — "override clone judiciously"; thực tế nên tránh Cloneable cho API mới.)
answer_html_en:
clone() lives on Object but the mechanism is tangled:
- Cloneable is an empty marker — it declares no clone() method. It merely flips a flag so Object.clone() does not throw CloneNotSupportedException. An interface that defines no behavior is counter-intuitive.
- Object.clone() is a shallow copy: it copies surface fields only; reference fields (list, array, nested object) stay shared → mutating the clone corrupts the original.
- It does not call a constructor, is awkward with final fields, and requires a manual cast.

java
class Team implements Cloneable {
  List<String> members;
  @Override public Team clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
    Team t = (Team) super.clone();
    t.members = new ArrayList<>(members); // manual deep-copy per field
    return t;
  }
}

Recommended alternatives:
- Copy constructor: new Team(other) — explicit, works with final.
- Static factory: Team.copyOf(other).
- Immutable objects need no clone at all.

(Effective Java Item 13 — "override clone judiciously"; in practice, avoid Cloneable for new APIs.)
